name: Urn
tagline: Offline polls to decide and vote using Majority Judgment
blurb: Transform your phone into a mobile, offline urn for a local Majority Judgment poll.
description:
Transform your phone into a mobile, offline urn for a local Majority Judgment poll.

Setup a poll in seconds, and share the phone amongst participants.

This application helps groups decide together quickly about some subject.

Majority Judgment is an elegant ranking system used in french wine contests, where each participant judges each proposal, so there is no "throwing your vote away".
